detail: IndexedDB datastore opens and test-case access is removed from the app

390px mobile dashboard, entry, filters and data dialog have no horizontal page overflow; controls usable.
1280px desktop dashboard has no horizontal overflow; chart, budget, list and What’s New visible.
English voice transcript “250 Rs spent on groceries” immediately fills amount 250.00, Food & groceries, and description groceries; translated Spanish still requires acceptance.

At 390×844 without direct speech recognition, phone-keyboard Hindi and Spanish each translate to English, require acceptance, and apply INR 250, Food & groceries, and UPI.

At 390×844, a Hindi partial result followed by end-of-speech remains visible, translates to the correct English draft, and applies INR 250, Food & groceries and UPI only after approval.
